_comment: Known org resources. env: variables checked first (real environment, then .env). legacy: older places a value may sit (profile key path, or a file under site-pack/ and a key). credential: variable names whose presence is reported, never their values. Register a value with: python3 scripts/resources.py set <name> <value>.

uisp.purpose: UISP controller: devices, sites, config backups

librenms.purpose: LibreNMS: sysName, hardware and location corroboration (not site truth)

mymate.purpose: MyMate network monitor: device status, outages, ping history

tower_directory.purpose: Google Sheet: Tower Directory (master tower list)

ip_network.purpose: Google Sheet: IP Network sheetbook and Temp OSPF tabs
